execution_policy: Constrained declarative DSL only (AXIOM or AND premise references); no code execution, scripts, external calls or action dispatch.

cases.scenario: Exact-version registered AND rule consumes admissible source-backed facts from a version-bound premise set and exact query match.
cases.expected: Deterministic conclusion, conservative minimum-support confidence and complete derivation trace.

cases.scenario: Rule content digest, rule-set digest, premise-set binding, query digest, evaluator version or confidence policy differs.
Unknown rule, unapproved AXIOM, unsupported expression, executable syntax or template interpolation is supplied.
Antecedent is missing, ambiguous, unknown or has an epistemic status not allowed by the rule.
cases.expected: No derived conclusion; unsupported premise reason retained.

cases.scenario: Two rules with the same conclusion ID produce different conclusion templates.
cases.expected: Conflicting derivations rejected; no arbitrary winner selected.

cases.scenario: Confidence is missing/out of range, duplicate IDs exist, or step limit is exceeded.
cases.expected: Fail closed with no unsupported confidence inflation.
